baseline_metrics: Steady-state baseline: 180 QPS across chat + search (average payload 220 tokens/request).
Peak-day burst: up to 1,200 QPS for 90 minutes (marketing flash sale).
Peak token/sec: estimated 260k tokens/sec during flash sale (conservative headroom applied).
Desired p50/p95 latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for chat responses (100-300 token responses).
Batch embedding jobs: nightly window 3am-6am, 500k documents/day, lower priority scheduling ok.
sla_targets: Uptime: target 99.9% for production routes (SLA credit thresholds requested).
Latency SLOs: p95 inference latency guarantees per route; fallback policy to lower-cost model if SLO breached.
Throughput guarantee: baseline sustained throughput 180 QPS with autoscale headroom to 300 QPS without manual intervention.
Incident response: 1-hr P1 response, 4-hr mitigation window requested in contract.
Data residency: all EU customer profiles must remain in EU region; audit logs retained 12 months.
reserved_gpu_plan: Proposal v2 (internal): Reserved pool = 8 GPUs (H100-equivalent) for baseline; 2 spare hot-swap GPUs for buffer.
Autoscale policy: burst capacity via pre-warmed dedicated reserve (billing model: reserved + burst credits).
Quantization guidance: try 4-bit for rerank models in non-critical paths; keep full precision for checkout chat.
Cost optimization: use Optimize team recommendations to shift 40% of traffic to cached responses + prefix cache to save tokens/sec.
POC plan: 4-week pilot with 4 reserved GPUs, synthetic load to validate latency SLOs, then scale to full reserved pool.
